content: Numerical validation methodology: llama.cpp tests/test-quantize-fns.cpp uses fixed max-error constants per bit width (e.g. total error 0.002 default, tighter for higher bits); test-backend-ops.cpp compares every op against CPU reference backend with per-op tolerances + perf mode; tools/perplexity supports --kl-divergence vs fp16 logits on Wikitext-2 (PRs #5076/#6936 KLD scoreboard); industry verify harnesses (Modular) combine tol+cosine+KL metrics with defaults rel 1e-3/abs 1e-4/cos 1e-3/KL 1e-3.
